audience: freelancers and teams that manage client work in Plutio

useCases.title: Review project progress and overdue tasks
useCases.text: The AI reads projects and their tasks, checks project status and due dates, and identifies overdue work for a client or project.

useCases.title: Review outstanding invoices
useCases.text: The AI reads invoice status, amounts paid and due dates, then checks associated transactions to help you review outstanding client balances.

useCases.title: Create a client and a project
useCases.text: The AI adds a client record and creates a project for that client after you confirm the details.

useCases.title: Record time against a task
useCases.text: The AI reads a task to check its project, then records the duration you provide against that task after confirmation.

useCases.title: Prepare a draft invoice with line items
useCases.text: The AI creates a draft invoice for a person or company and adds its initial line items after you confirm the details. The invoice is not emailed and cannot yet be paid.

useCases.title: Read a proposal or contract
useCases.text: The AI finds a proposal or contract and retrieves its content blocks so you can review the written terms alongside its status.
